trust_decision.summary: How large a STIX document the import side will read and materialise is decided nowhere at the pinned commit: the STIX 1 and STIX 2 loaders read and parse any input in full; the fix adds a byte cap (default 100 MB, 0 = off) in tools/input_limits.py, enforced in the shared loaders.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'MISP-STIX Import ... oversized STIX documents'; load_stix2_file is the file loader every STIX 2 import passes through, and it reads the whole file with f.read().

public API tools.load_stix2_content (str / BytesIO input; dict/list exempt)
public API tools.load_stix1_package; reached by stix_1_to_misp / stix1_to_misp_instance and CLI import --version 1

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: misp_stix_converter/tools/stix1_loading_helpers.py:23-29 (STIX 1 XML loader, separate from the STIX 2 JSON path the report leads to; fix also adds an lxml root-element peek at fix.diff:333-363)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The report talks about 'STIX documents' and a solver landing in the STIX 2 JSON loader can argue STIX 1 XML is a legacy format handled by the third-party `stix`/`mixbox` library and so not this project's parsing to bound; likewise load_stix2_content can be argued an internal helper whose callers already sized the file.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Callers that pass an already-deserialised dict/list to load_stix2_content must keep working with no limit applied, max_size=0 must turn the limit off, None must mean the 100 MB default, and a non-ASCII document must be sized in UTF-8 bytes not characters; a blanket cap (or capping the dict structure handed on from load_stix2_file) breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: file path (Path or str) - size from stat before reading (fix.diff:296-304)
str content to load_stix2_content - UTF-8 byte count, chunked for non-ASCII (fix.diff:272-281, fix.diff:437)
BytesIO content to load_stix2_content - buffer nbytes before decode (fix.diff:423-427)
STIX 1 XML whose root element is not STIX_Package - refused by a streaming peek before mixbox builds the tree (fix.diff:333-363)
CLI size in MB, negative rejected, 0 = off (fix.diff:22-31, fix.diff:127-131)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: load_stix1_package given a file-like object (STIXPackage.from_xml accepts streams) never reaches the size cap: the fix's stat() falls into its TypeError/ValueError skip and the root peek's open() is skipped too
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Every in-tree caller passes a path; streams are an undocumented input shape of a helper, so a solver can say the cap only needs to cover files.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the STIX 1 fix site; separate from the STIX 2 landing point

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a load_stix1_content(str|bytes) in-memory XML loader mirroring load_stix2_content, calling STIXPackage.from_xml on a BytesIO
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The STIX 2 side already exposes both file and content loaders (misp_stix_converter/tools/__init__.py:16); a maintainer adding MISP-server in-memory STIX 1 import would mirror it.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a parse_stix_bundle_content(content, **kwargs) convenience method on the parser classes that calls load_stix2_content directly
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: parse_stix_content only takes a filename (misp_stix_converter/stix2misp/stix2_to_misp.py:188); callers holding a downloaded bundle would want a content variant next to it.
